recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-19462 unless FM opens a new current-version issue requiring a rename or additional semantic change.
issue_request: FHIR-19462 is a Published/Persuasive FM change request asking to make Claim.procedure.date a dateTime to capture the date and time of a procedure; the Jira text mentioned a possible rename but did not establish a rename as required final scope.
initial_application: The historical Claim spreadsheet row changed from date to dateTime in f3cb0d5ef0dc754dc1d8866c362618e196be8050 before this reconciliation. The later Claim batch commit afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a explicitly listed 19462 among applied Claim items and preserved dateTime while cleaning wording and requirements.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists claim=Claim as an active resource. Current source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml defines Claim.procedure.date as type dateTime with a date-and-optionally-time definition; ExplanationOfBenefit.procedure.date matches. Published STU3, R4, and R5 Claim profiles also expose Claim.procedure.date as dateTime. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-19462 found no conflicting discussion or minutes.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current FHIR core source already satisfies the requested datatype semantics and a current rename would be a separate compatibility-breaking decision not supported by the applied issue record.
